title: feat(local): shared read-only package store for tier 2
body:
### Motivation
- Eight worktrees each carried an identical 7.3 GB `.lake/packages` tree, pushing disk use to 97%. This owner-directed change addresses #50.

### Description
- Store tier 2 once per manifest/toolchain key under `$CACHE_ROOT/packages/` and link each worktree only to its exact key.
- Serialize the first fetch and publication under the full-build lock; validate the staged tree before atomic publication and preserve private trees on failure.
- Refresh each nested package Git index after the staged tree becomes read-only, then remove index write bits before publication.
- Make setup, CI, cache warming, and housekeeping validate the exact link and read-only modes before and after builds.
- Reject relative cache roots and top-level package symlinks before mutation, fail before building when package preparation fails, and invoke setup through the trusted primary checkout.
- Track lock/signal hardening in #54, recursive containment/crash recovery in #55, and cross-filesystem publication in #56.
- Keep the whole PR at exactly 400 changed lines: 312 additions and 88 deletions, without `MIPSTARRE_INFRA_OVERRIDE`.

### Testing
- All 431 workflow unit tests passed in the final commit hook at `5f7377a`.
- The focused regression covers exact keys, concurrent publication, retry-time external-symlink safety, package failure before build, temporary lock isolation, private-tree preservation, stale links, and read-only validation.
- Affected shell syntax checks, `git diff --check`, trusted-primary setup `--check`, and the live shared-store mode audit passed.
- Exact-head CI and review will be rerun at `5f7377a` before merge.

---
Closes #50

title: feat(QPBT): expose extraction decoding and re-exports
body:
### Motivation
- Implement the Stage 4.2 Chapter 16 extraction skeleton from the approved issue #19 packet, exposing the concrete swap construction and preserving the paper-facing proof frontier.
- The declarations follow `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1415-1877` and the synchronized Chapter 16 blueprint.

### Description
- Add heterogeneous extraction-register bookkeeping, dot-product Pauli projectors, polynomial marginals, pulled-apart measurements and observables, and swap conjugation interfaces.
- Add consistency obligations and the concrete `ExtractionWitness` with normalized auxiliary state, swapped-state comparison, player-side Pauli comparisons, and the quantitative robustness obligation.
- Record the four Chapter 16 paper-gap notes and keep all unresolved mathematics as named proposition-valued obligations without bridge or residual assumptions.

### Testing
- Focused `lake env lean` and `lake build` checks passed for the extraction modules in their dependency order.
- `leanblueprint web`, `lake exe checkdecls blueprint/lean_decls`, repository pre-commit, and `git diff --check` passed for the landed worker units; aggregate re-export and final exact-head CI will run after #18 merges.


---
Closes #19

title: fix(infrastructure): replace same-head review bodies
body:
### Motivation
- Resolve issue #8 / review finding F4: rerunning a review on the same head SHA must replace stale marker-matched review text so GitHub evidence reflects the latest verdict.

### Description
- Update `gh_common.post_review` to PUT the fresh body into an existing marker-matched COMMENT review on the same commit.
- Preserve marker-based create/adopt behavior and return the review id for both paths.
- Update workflow tests to assert replacement of stale review bodies.

### Testing
- `python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_github_workflow`
- `git diff main...HEAD --check`

---
Closes #8
